description:
## What's New in 0.2.1

- **Non-experimental LINE `26.19.0` target declaration**: Sets `AppTarget.isExperimental = false` for LINE `26.19.0` (`261900178`) so Morphe Manager lists it as a standard supported version without requiring **Experimental app versions** or **Pre-release patches**, and enforces `isExperimental` parity in `tests/test_bundle_metadata.py`.
- **Full `0.2.0` LINE `26.19.0` (`261900178`) port included**: Retains all LINE `26.19.0` port fixes (13-parameter `Lti5/a0;<init>` `v16` register overflow + `IPUT_BOOLEAN` tracing in `SettingsPatch.kt`, `Header.setUpButtonVisibility$common_libs` + `duplicateParentState=false` in `SettingsPage`, DI `ch8.c`/`eh8.e.b` in `NativeLine.muted()`, `Lln3/k$d;->b` unread count, `ReadActions` `q08.b` `onComplete`/`b` swap, Glide `X(Integer.MIN_VALUE, Integer.MIN_VALUE)`, `Lsm8/c;` continuation bridge, notification hooks, and native action resource IDs `0x7f152a17`/`0x7f152a18`).

### Included Patches (LINE `26.19.0` / `261900178`, Patcher `2.3.0`, all `default = true`)
- `Notification settings`: Adds localized patch settings UI & notification button presets.
- `Not Too Much Silent`: Local silent mode (chat menu, chat-list long-press, notification shade) with opt-in `@mention` & keyword alert bypass + complete hide.
- `More Chat Info`: Android `MessagingStyle` conversation preview (configurable `1–25` recent unread) + total unread count + typed & detailed attachment labels + optional inline photo/sticker previews + local-cache sender avatars.
- `No reply`: Hides smart-reply chips while keeping manual inline reply.
- `Mark as read`: Marks whole regular chat read via LINE's native chat-list updater.
- `Restore push registration`: Restores Firebase installation registration after re-signing (`X-Android-Cert` only).

### Verification & Notes
- Verified with 224 `NotificationPolicy` assertions, 279 `ExtensionRuntimeTest` JVM behavioral checks (45 scenarios), 29 Python unit tests, 5 APK static contract suites (3,198 ARM64 & Universal all-features; 3,134 `Mark as read`-only; 3,156 `More Chat Info`-only; 3,176 `Not Too Much Silent`-only), compiled `resources.arsc` checks (77 keys × 7 locales), independent `gpt-6.2-astra` bytecode cross-check, and live Galaxy S10e LINE `26.19.0` same-key upgrade + Smoke A/B/C verification with 0 logcat errors across 47,217 lines.
- Original/patched LINE APKs, APKMs, and signing keys are never distributed. Provide your own official LINE `26.19.0` APKM.
- Licensed under GPL-3.0 with `NOTICE`, `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`, source archive, and `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

patches.name: Mark as read
patches.description: Replaces mute with a button that marks the whole chat as read and clears its notification using LINE's native chat-list path. Enable in LINE settings.

patches.name: More Chat Info
patches.description: Shows configurable recent unread messages (1–25) in conversation style with total unread count, sender profile avatars (local cache only), optional inline photo/video/sticker thumbnail previews (loaded via LINE's image loader when enabled), and typed attachment labels ([Photo], [Video], [Sticker], [File] filename, [Location] place) across notifications, popups, and the chat list. Enable in LINE settings.

patches.name: No reply
patches.description: Hides suggested replies while keeping manual inline reply. Enable in LINE notification patch settings.

patches.name: Not Too Much Silent
patches.description: Turns chat-menu, chat-list, and notification mute into local silent mode with optional @mention and keyword alert bypass; adds a completely-hidden chat menu option.

patches.name: Notification settings
patches.description: Adds localized notification patch settings to LINE (7 locales: EN, KO, JA, ZH-TW, ZH-CN, TH, ID). All switches start disabled.

patches.name: Restore push registration
patches.description: Restores Firebase installation registration after re-signing. Changes the reported certificate for FIS requests only.
